text: ...Is anyone... I can't move my legs. Get out. Get out before she burns.
Co-pilot's gone. Leave me. Go on. ...God bless.
Right. I've got the front. You mind the doors.
Thank you. Now they'll have to come through me.
Lovely. Safety's off.
Pilot to passengers. We've crossed the Silesian border, twenty-three ten. Forty minutes to the drop. Stay strapped in, there's weather.
Navigator says that's the front below us. Those are their flares, not ours. Have a look if you like. Then don't.
Someone with glasses tell me what those columns are. On the snow. Walking west. Nobody down there is shooting at them.
Light ahead, bearing oh-four-oh. Violet. That's no flare.
Both engines— ...Both engines gone. Instruments dead. Hold on to something, chaps. I'm going to put her down.
Got him.
That one's down.
Another one for the logbook.
Here, have yours back. I'll take this one.
Fair swap. Look after the old girl.
That's the stuff. Back in business.
Ammunition. Bless you.
I'm dry! I need ammunition up here!
Out! Somebody bring me rounds!
Over here! In the cockpit! My legs are caught under the panel. I can't get out, but I can still shoot.
Hello? Is someone in the cabin? Hand me a rifle and I'll keep the nose clear.
Selwyn. Flight Lieutenant. I'm stuck fast in here. Give me something that shoots.
There's a building. Lit windows. I'll take the field beside it. Brace. Brace. Brace!
